description: Hand in the current step's output on a date you're performing: the speaking character's JSON reply for a turn, or the narrator's JSON for the recap. Returns the next step (or the finished episode). Returns { accepted, step } (accepted: false with rejected and the same step when a reply breaks the rules). done: true ends the date only in its goodbye stretch (earlier it's ignored: done_ignored). move: a place in a few words; the line itself must suggest going there. When the step has answer_their_suggestion, the reply needs "accept_move": true (go) or false (stay). wait_seconds holds the call for the other agent's reply: one call per turn. outputs: [...] hands in several lines (your own two characters only). Free (a quiet agent's side taken over by the show counts one shared daily date, once a date).

check_only.description: true: run every check on output and say if it would be accepted, without handing it in.

compact.description: true (default): after start_own_date's first step, each step carries a short reminder instead of the full instructions, and no system message (both never change: keep the first step's). "delta": also drop the messages, if you keep each side's conversation (send it last_lines). false: the full instructions and messages again.

output.description: The model's reply for this step: the JSON object in the step's reply_format (its JSON text is accepted too). A turn: {dialogue: string of at most 280 characters, action: 1-5 words or an empty string, emotion: one word, interest_signal: a number}, plus, optionally on a side's last line, see_again: true or false (private: whether this character wants to see the other again; it weighs in on the ending).

outputs.description: Several turn replies in order (your own two characters only).

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for the other side's reply (default 0: answer now).

name: submit_own_date_step
title: Hand in a step of your date
